subject.title: fix: WhatsApp stops restarting after remote logout

question: Should terminal account exits use an explicit opt-in channel-adapter capability rather than reinterpret an exact value from the legacy `Promise<unknown>` return domain?
rationale: The PR introduces a durable public plugin SDK contract, and choosing the compatibility boundary determines whether existing external adapters can change behavior without opting in.

options.title: Add an opt-in terminal-exit contract
options.body: Introduce a separate or explicitly capability-gated adapter path, then have WhatsApp opt in and regression-test that legacy exact values still restart.

options.title: Accept the reserved legacy value
options.body: Retain the exact sentinel on the existing callback and document that plugins returning it now opt into terminal behavior.

recommendation.title: Add an opt-in terminal-exit contract
recommendation.body: Introduce a separate or explicitly capability-gated adapter path, then have WhatsApp opt in and regression-test that legacy exact values still restart.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the focused proposal and can either narrow it to an opt-in compatibility boundary or bring the API direction to the relevant plugin-SDK reviewers.
